title: Interview Toolkit
summary: Everything around the questions: resume and project stories, company research, group discussion, tough questions, salary and offers, and interview day.
outcomes: Explain your resume and projects clearly
Research a company and read a job description
Take part in a group discussion with structure
Handle tough questions and what you do not know
Prepare for the interview day and follow up
